headline: A 1948 coffee house running 77 Google ads - through an agency, with no local landing pages.
ad_intro: Cothas is one of the few legacy Bengaluru coffee brands actually investing in paid media: 77 live Google Ads creatives, verified under Freeflow Creative Services India Pvt Ltd - i.e. the account is agency-managed. The inventory includes Local store ads (we captured 'Cothas Coffee HMT Road Mathikere'), which is exactly the right instinct for a brand whose growth now runs on vending machines, CoCo outlets and e-commerce. The leak is that the paid clicks land on a general site while the strongest demand signals - 'coffee vending machine', 'CoCo outlet near me', 'filter coffee subscription' - deserve their own destination pages.

findings: One destination for three different buyers: a cafe owner looking for a vending machine, a household buying filter coffee, and a CoCo outlet visitor are three different funnels. With 77 creatives live, the ad copy is already segmented - the landing pages are not.

Vending is your B2B goldmine: 'coffee vending machine' is a high-intent, high-LTV query with a long decision cycle. It needs a dedicated page with ROI proof (cups/day, payback), a lead form, and retargeting - not a generic products page.
Local store ads without local proof: the HMT Road Mathikere local ad is the right move; it should land on a store page with timings, directions and one-tap call - and be measured per store.

No UGC around the ritual: filter coffee is the most social drink in South India. The account shows little user-generated 'my morning filter coffee' content; this is free creative volume you are not collecting.
competitors: Strong D2C brand storytelling and subscription mechanics.
Cothas wins on heritage + vending scale - say it in the ad and on the page.
Deep retail distribution and price-led messaging.
Own 'since 1948' authenticity and brew-quality proof in paid social.
Direct sales teams with ROI calculators.
Publish a vending ROI calculator page and retarget every download.
wins: WIN 1 - Landing pages: one page per buyer

Split the paid traffic into three destinations: Household (filter coffee subscription), B2B (vending machine enquiry with ROI calculator + form), and Store (CoCo outlet locator with timings and directions).

Turn the vending line into a lead machine: a dedicated page, a 10-field enquiry form, WhatsApp handoff, and a 3-touch retargeting sequence (case study -> ROI -> offer). B2B vending deals are worth many D2C orders each.
Run a monthly #MyCothasFilter contest collecting customer photos/videos; the best 10 become paid creatives. Zero production cost, real social proof, endless creative supply.
impact: Higher lead capture, better lead quality
More calls and walk-ins per store
Lower cost per creative, higher trust
More repeat orders, more B2B pipeline
